MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Traveller feels like a natural next choice because its bluesy country sound connects my interest in Blown Away with the blues and roots direction of Memphis and Old Sock.",
    "Same Trailer Different Park appeals to my interest in country songwriting, while Eagles: The Very Best Of connects with the familiar classic rock side of my listening."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "25 and Oscd Ad Adele 21 lean toward mainstream pop, which does not give me the bluesy guitar and roots feel I want right now.",
    "Partners and Earth Wind & Fire Greatest Hits offer vocal duets or funk rather than the sound drawing me back to my recent albums.",
    "The Essentials gives me too little information about the music to judge whether I would enjoy it, so I would skip it."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in familiar artists seems to have been stretched into an interest in greatest-hits collections, even though I am more interested in trying another album right now.",
    "My interest in Blown Away seems to have been taken as a broader appetite for mainstream vocal music, when the country songwriting connection matters more to me."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The shared blues and roots feel of Memphis, Old Sock, and People, Hell & Angels matters more to my current choice than simply recognizing an artist or title.",
    "An album can fit my taste without making me want to choose it today: Wallflower and the country recommendations appeal, but Traveller gives me the strongest combination of bluesy sound and country songwriting."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly understood my country and classic rock interests but missed how strongly blues and roots music guide what I want to try next."
}
